Class RentalService

java.lang.Object
com.vrms.application.RentalService
public class RentalService extends Object
Provides the application logic required to rent and return vehicles.

The service validates rental periods, prevents double booking, applies type-specific vehicle rules, updates vehicle status, saves rental records, closes returned rentals, and calculates rental costs using a selected pricing strategy.

      public RentalService(com.vrms.persistence.VehicleRepository vehicleRepository, com.vrms.persistence.RentalRepository rentalRepository, com.vrms.application.DateProvider dateProvider)
      Creates a rental service using the provided repositories and date provider.

      The date provider can be mocked during testing so that date-dependent behavior does not depend on the real system date.

      Parameters:
      vehicleRepository - repository containing vehicle records
      rentalRepository - repository containing rental records
      dateProvider - provider used to obtain the current date
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any dependency is null

    • rentVehicle

      public com.vrms.domain.Rental rentVehicle(String rentalId, String vehicleId, String customerName, String customerEmail, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate)
      Creates a rental using default validation information.

      Car and van rentals may use this method because they do not require additional type-specific information.

      Parameters:
      rentalId - unique rental identifier
      vehicleId - identifier of the selected vehicle
      customerName - customer name
      customerEmail - customer email address
      startDate - rental start date
      endDate - rental end date
      Returns:
      newly created rental
